Method of Attack: AutoSpill attack exploiting Android autofill framework to steal account credentials during autofill operation
Capturing auto-filled credentials on invoking app without JavaScript injection
JavaScript injection enabling full vulnerability to AutoSpill
Discoverer: Security researchers from the International Institute of Information Technology (IIIT) at Hyderabad
Attack Vector: Malicious Android app using WebView to host login form and capture autofilled credentials
Exploitation of Android autofill framework weaknesses
